Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the incident report posted yesterday. Greenline saw an availability gap on May 12 (approx 03:20–06:35 PDT) that affected our inference traffic for the patient triage service. Our engineering and ops teams captured the attached timeline and usage export for the window.

Per our contract we want to confirm whether this qualifies for SLA remediation and if so request a credit calculation and any required evidence for our procurement group. Our billing contact (cc'd) may need a credit memo or invoice adjustment.

Attached: incident-timeline-GL-20250512.pdf, usage-export-202505.csv

Best,

Elena — thanks for the details and the attachments. I reviewed the timeline and opened an internal credit calculation ticket (BILL-4571).

Quick summary / next steps:
- Confirming incident window we see in our logs: 03:18–06:36 PDT (roughly 198 minutes).
- Our standard SLA remediation requires: 1) confirmed incident window, 2) customer usage during the window or monthly bill, and 3) approval from finance to issue a credit memo.
- I attached a working spreadsheet (credit-calc-GL-20250512.xlsx) to the ticket; it contains a preliminary estimate using the prorated method in Section 4.2 of the SOW.

Preliminary estimate (subject to finance sign-off): $12,480 credit. I included the calculation steps in the workbook and the assumptions used.

Marissa / Michael — looping you in to confirm approval path and whether we should issue a credit memo or a billing adjustment. Elena, we'll plan to follow up with a formal credit memo and the calculation breakdown within 3 business days.

Subject: RE: May 12 outage — request for credit calculation and timeline

Team — I reviewed the spreadsheet Stephanie linked. A few operational notes and a suggested path:

1) Customer contract: Greenline is on a committed dedicated plan (quarterly billing) — credit should be a credit memo against current quarter invoice.
2) Calculation basis: use the prorated share of monthly committed fee for the impacted window; attach the usage-export so procurement can reconcile.
3) Proposed amount for approval: $12,480 (matches the workbook; includes a 1.5x remediation multiplier for service-level class B outages per SOW section 4.2).

Michael — can you please approve the issuance of a credit memo in that amount and confirm GL account code to route the memo? If you prefer a different form of remediation (discount on next invoice vs immediate credit), let me know — customer prefers immediate credit memo.

Thanks — I will prep the credit memo draft and the cover note to the customer once we have finance sign-off.

—Marissa
